event: US jobless claims today, likely 15:30 SAST (time UNVERIFIED). US PPI expected Fri 13 Nov (date and time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Bounce faded
bullets.text: Gold bounced to about 3,998.71 overnight (Mitrade) but slipped back to 3,971.70-3,974.57 (Trading Economics), so 4,000 held as a ceiling.

bullets.title: Testing the low
bullets.text: Thursday's low so far is 3,968.82 (Mitrade), and FX Leaders reports price testing 3,969 as the dollar climbs.

bullets.title: Dollar at highs
bullets.text: The dollar index is about 102.84-102.99, a yearly high and the strongest since April 2025, and the US 10-year yield is near 5.00%.

bullets.title: December hike priced
bullets.text: Markets price about an 87% chance of a December Fed hike (Mitrade, Amillex), though Trading Economics says 91% (sources differ).

bullets.title: Hot inflation
bullets.text: October core CPI rose 0.3% for a third month versus 0.2% expected, and Waller said a 50 bp December hike may be necessary.

bullets.title: Fast money left
bullets.text: Managed-money longs fell to a 21-week low, while central banks bought 321 t in Q3 and China's PBOC added 25.8 t in October (Mitrade).

bullets.title: Iran and oil
bullets.text: Hormuz shipping disruptions show little sign of easing and Brent is near 90 dollars, which keeps some safe-haven demand in play (Amillex).
